hypothesis: M3 fixed-assignment physical E2 site MIPs retain cross-trip clocks and original serial vehicles; their ObjBound floors can improve the complete original MILP enough to repay preprocessing cost. Unlike route-cover LP, no physical serial relaxation inside each site.
scope: First fixed M3 only. No full Benders or M4 assignment decomposition claim. Site decomposition relaxes E1 routing/supply coupling but retains original necessary supply lower bounds.

policy.site_allocation: equal remaining component budget across remaining sites; serial; no retry
policy.cuts: individual original E2 site objective floors

correctness: Independent tiny full integer enumeration bounds, duplicate customers, nonmetric and zero times
Original full schedules projected by fixing E2 paths, times and supply; all tasks and same physical vehicle routes
Local objective uses unique raw E2 arc variables; no double count compressed arcs
Only finite valid ObjBound with conservative margin; timeout UNKNOWN cannot prove infeasibility; no partial site sums masquerade as full proof
Every original large output audited and periodic-replayed; positive site bounds independently re-solve saved MPS or a changed representation before adoption

matrix.budget_scope: load/audit + component build/solve + original MILP + application under total budget; imports separate

gate: Only after all correctness/audits/regressions pass: >=8/12 pairs improve final gap by >1e-5 including both sources, all seeds and budgets, no gap regression >1e-5; OR all pairs reach original integer optimality with >=10% total time and Work reduction in each source/budget aggregate. Otherwise closed experiment only. No favorable reruns.
failures: Preserve all failed logs/code; no timed-job automatic retry; correctness fixture repairs retained separately.
